verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's own materials say every document becomes part of the knowledge base and that users can chat with their docs via built-in RAG. A hands-on user who ran it over a batch of regulatory PDFs found the answers largely correct, though the citation window showed garbled content. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on document ingestion and supported formats (including notes), reliable source citations for grounding (a hands-on user reported garbled citation content).

support.subject: As a power user, I can attach my own documents and notes as a knowledge base and get grounded answers over them

citations.quote: Every document becomes part of your agent's knowledge base with no data leaving your device.
Chat with your docs, use AI Agents, hyper-configurable, multi-user, & no frustrating setup required.
RAG, agents, and work right out of the box
